units.name: Division of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: Current official expanded division inventory explicitly names Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, offers MSc/PhD Logistics and Supply Chain Management, and identifies logistics, decision sciences, Operations Research and system optimization research. Its PhD programme directly concerns production, inventory, transport, routing and industrial systems.

decisions.reason: Current division inventory places PhD LSCM within Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, but the current standalone PhD page still names Engineering Management and Decision Sciences. Relevant current division independently verified; exact old/new unit succession or concurrent administrative relationship remains unresolved, with no forced historical rename claim.
